prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the basic modules of computer science are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can present and apply common data bionic methods.
Students can discuss the possibilities and limitations of nature-analogous information processing.
Students are able to design a solution using data bionic methods, starting from a specific problem.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating, and solving problems.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to known theories of nature-analogous information processing
Ant Colony Optimization & Particle Swarm Optimization

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points achieved)
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: Grading is based on a point scale from 0 to 15 points, according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Data Science degree program. To acquire the performance points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The final examination performance is an oral examination or a written examination.
